data.long_meaning: From the Latin word 'vivus' meaning alive, this name is given to a girl with a lively and vivacious spirit. The name Viviane carries the meaning “Lively, vivacious” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Viviane usually hope their child will grow to embody lively, vivacious and live with faith, good character and purpose.
